proposed:lfm3_vl_2b.context_note: Native context is a model limit, not a suggested allocation. Qwen extensions and Granite 512K need separate validated long-context profiles.

vision_profile.role: First compact visual worker to evaluate for descriptions, image review, OCR, grounding and GUI screenshots.
vision_profile.vram_tier_evidence: Planning estimate only, not a measured guarantee. CPU operation needs sufficient host RAM. Disk bytes exclude context, vision and compute buffers.

vision_profile.task_limits: The publisher does not recommend this checkpoint for coding, multi-turn conversations or complex reasoning. Use as a focused visual worker; retain the existing text assistant for conversation and persona.
vision_profile.reasoning_control: The base template defaults enable_thinking=true. Set chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for fast captions/reviews; retain thinking as an explicit advanced mode. preserve_thinking controls history retention, not whether new reasoning is generated.

image_budget.note: The proposed 1MP ceiling is an application budget, not a vendor default. Bound image processing and context; do not inherit the 16MP ceiling for a low-memory profile.

integration_notes: Official llama.cpp support requires b11960+ / v0.8.0+, and LM Studio llama.cpp engine 2.65.1+. The runtime agent must verify the bundled binary and wrapper image path.

Runtime source audit found first LFM3-VL support at b11938, newer than released xllamacpp snapshot b11870. Native b12110 supports it and includes a later reasoning-budget/schema fix at b12004. Mark the embedded backend unavailable until it is upgraded; do not advertise support merely because text-only LFM3 loads.

Q4_0 here is a separate quantization-aware-distillation checkpoint, not a generic post-training Q4_0. It was trained to recover Q4_0 accuracy. Q4_K_M is a fallback candidate, not an automatic upgrade.
Use the native template and processor. Do not manually paste image sentinel tokens into plain text.

Native tool calls use the Qwen3-Coder-style XML representation. The template expects function arguments as mappings; decode OpenAI argument JSON strings before formatting history when required by the wrapper.
Preserve the current tool turn and resend tool definitions. Do not strip reasoning needed by an in-progress tool turn merely to hide it from UI.
Video is 2fps with 4–768 frames by default; current llama.cpp video-fps does not override that. Video support is not necessary for this image-focused addition.
NVFP4 is a separate NVIDIA-optimized checkpoint and needs b12088+; older builds may load it yet produce incorrect output. Keep it out of the generic CPU/AMD default.

vendor_comparison.caveat: Vendor-run and not local Q4. Peers used reasoning enabled where supported; InternVL used its better mode per benchmark. Do not present the LFM thinking score as its low-latency nonthinking quality.
